resources.string: All your file tools in one place
Reach a measured maximum file size without uploading.
More native tools are in validation. Only tested workflows are shown as available.
Lightweight tools run locally. High-fidelity document conversion uses the configured secure temporary service, and each tool identifies its processing path.

FileFlow tools process documents on this device without a conversion server or login. Recent activity stores metadata only. Existing advertising SDKs may use the network; document processing does not depend on ads.
PDF and Office layouts differ, and unusual fonts or drawing layers can still vary. Scanned table extraction requires approved OCR. Already optimized files may not become smaller.
Processed locally. FileFlow does not upload this image.
Compression failed. Try a smaller image.
Could not safely reach %1$d KB. Measured output: %2$s.
Enter a target from 10 KB to 10240 KB.
This file is not a supported JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Choose an image smaller than 30 MB.
Compress JPG, PNG or WebP while measuring the actual output.
Recent activity stores metadata only. Shared outputs and camera captures can remain in app cache until Android clears it or the app is uninstalled.

Extract aligned multi-column rows locally, correct the quoted tab-separated preview, then export separate worksheets. Compare with the original: table structure is estimated and merged or multiline cells may need correction. All values stay as text to protect IDs, dates and currency. Scans need OCR. Limit: 20 MB, 100 pages.

Reconstruct editable paragraphs, headings, columns, ruled tables with rectangular merged cells, and positioned images locally. Page dimensions and inferred headers or footers are retained. Fonts may be substituted; complex artwork and substantial editing may change layout. Review the output. Scans need OCR. Limit: 20 MB, 100 pages.

This Android build has no embedded Word layout renderer. To preserve document formatting offline, open the original DOCX in an installed office app with PDF export. FileFlow cannot automatically receive its output. The separate basic text exporter discards layout; it is not accurate document conversion.
The office app cannot access this document. Select the DOCX again to renew read access. No PDF was generated.
Installed office app — export PDF there
Shares the selected DOCX with the office app you choose. Choose an offline office app to keep processing on your device.
Uploads the selected file to %1$s for office rendering. No automatic fallback to basic text export.
In the office app, choose Export as PDF or Print → Save as PDF. The office app saves the result; FileFlow has not generated a PDF.
No office app opened this DOCX. Install an app such as Collabora Office, or explicitly select Basic text PDF if formatting loss is acceptable.

Recompress opaque bitmap images locally without rasterizing text pages. Quality presets can reduce image detail. Transparent or oversized images are skipped. If no reduction is found, the original is retained. Signed PDFs are rejected. Limit: 20 MB, 100 pages.
Merge PDFs, rotate every page, or split a PDF into individual files in a ZIP archive.
Convert a real JPG, PNG or WebP image locally. JPEG replaces transparent pixels with white.
Prepare a photo, signature or document to measured size and maximum dimensions. Verify the destination portal’s current rules.
Capture, detect document edges, correct perspective, enhance and arrange up to 50 pages.
This document is transferred over HTTPS to the configured FileFlow service with temporary workspace cleanup attempted after each request.
Processed locally on this device. No document bytes are uploaded.
Recover scanned pages with offline Latin OCR. English/Latin text only; not Urdu. Review every word and value. Scan images and original formatting are not retained. Up to 10 scanned pages per batch.
Arrange multiple JPG, PNG or WebP images and create a real multipage PDF locally.
